[LSER.13.9] **The block-option inventory is closed.** A series declaration
accepts exactly `by:`, `capacity:` ([LSER.13.14]) and `nulls:`
([LNUL.8.6]), in parentheses on the declaration line ([LSER.13.4]).

Each is its own production, so an unknown option name is a **parse** error
rather than a validation one — there is no kwarg-name check left to fail,
because there is no open kwarg position for a wrong name to occupy. `window:`
is not an option: the window is the time-model phrase on the observation line
([LSER.13.1]).
